scientific_integrity: Complete all-parameter proof provided; finite exhaustive computation corroborates but does not replace proof. Earlier vertex theorem and first-diameter results are credited.
scientific_limitations: Standard Euclidean vertex distance only; n>=4, positive integer b and b1>=2. Does not address b1=1 or all continuous point distances. Indexed priority remains provisional.
title: Exact second vertex-distance shells of generalized parking-function polytopes
